item.title: Inevitable 'FNAF' Fan Game 'Five Nights At Epstein's Raises Eyebrows Across Social Media
item.description: Five Nights at Epstein's is a Five Nights at Freddy's (FNAF) fan game set on Epstein Island that replaces the animatronics with notable people implicated in the Epstein files, including Jeffrey Epstein, Stephen Hawking and Donald Trump. The game was created by Evan Productions and released in January 2026. It went viral through February 2026 as the subject of reactions and memes, many of which express shock over the game's existence.

item.title: The Optimal ‘Big Bad John’ Listening Experience: Big John Machines Explained
item.description: Big John Machine refers to a viral trend in which videos of high-end, extremely expensive home audio equipment playing Geoff Castelucci's cover of "Big Bad John" are shared on social media, particularly on TikTok. The name Big John Machine is derived from the song's usage amongst audiophiles for testing bass frequencies on audio equipment. The meme attracted significant attention in late 2025 to early 2026 due to the machines' exorbitant prices and bizarre build.
